title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blue Sour Razz 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Blue Sour Razz Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a tangy and exhilarating blend of Blue Raspberry with a sharp, sour twist. The sweet and tart balance makes for a vibrant vaping experience that’s ideal for fans of bold, fruity flavours with a sour edge. Designed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are crafted for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. Offering smooth throat hits and rapid nicotine absorption, these e-liquids are an excellent choice for vapers seeking a satisfying and enjoyable alternative to traditional tobacco products. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this flavour delivers an all-day vape that’s both sweet and sour. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand known for their vibrant and exciting e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range brings the most popular disposable vape flavours to a more versatile format for use with refillable devices. Be sure to explore other flavours from the collection, including Berry Blast, Lime Twist, and Raspberry Pomegranate.
